question: In a manual start sequence, when must the MASTER control switch be set to the ON position?

options.a: Immediately after pressing the MAN START P/B

justification: In manual mode, when N2 is at least 20%, the MASTER control switch must be set to the ON position ().

question: Which circuit breaker must be opened specifically for a 'dry crank' to ensure the HP fuel SOV remains closed?
justification: The manual states C/B 1KC1(2) (ENGINE HP FUEL SOV) is opened for dry crank only ().

question: What is the cooling period required after 4 consecutive starter cycles of 2 minutes each?
justification: An acceptable duty cycle involves up to four times, then 15 minutes off for cooling ().

question: What is the maximum duration the engine should be motored during a wet crank with the MASTER switch in ON?
justification: CAUTION: DO NOT MOTOR THE ENGINE FOR MORE THAN 15 SECONDS WITH THE MASTER CONTROL SWITCH IN THE ON POSITION during a wet crank ().

question: Running engagement of the starter is prohibited when N2 is above what value?
justification: The manual states 'no running engagement of the starter when N2 is above 20%' ().

question: How many total valves are used in the Variable Bleed Valve (VBV) system?
justification: The VBV system controls airflow using 12 valves ().

question: How are the 11 variable bleed valves driven by the master bleed valve?

options.b: Through a series of flexible shafts

justification: The master bleed valve drives the 11 remaining valves through a series of flexible shafts ().

question: Variable Stator Vane (VSV) angle is a function of core engine speed (N2) and what other parameter?
justification: Stator vane angle is a function of core engine speed (N2) and altitude ().

question: To where does the VBV system bypass air from the primary airflow?
justification: The VBV system by-passes air from the primary airflow into the secondary airflow ().

question: Where does the TBV discharge HPC 9th stage bleed air?
justification: The TBV unloads the HPC by discharging stage 9 HPC air in the LPT cavity ().

question: What air source is used by the LPT Active Clearance Control (LPTACC) for external case cooling?
justification: The LPTACC system uses fan air for external case cooling of the Low Pressure Turbine ().

question: Which compressor stages provide air to the HPTACC system to heat or cool the HPT shroud structure?
justification: The HPTACC system uses stage 4 and stage 9 HPC air to heat or cool the HPT shroud support structure ().

question: How is the predicted N1 value indicated on the cockpit N1 indicator?
justification: The predicted N1 is indicated by a blue circle on the N1 indicator ().

question: Which of these is NOT a thrust limit mode displayed on the ECAM?
justification: The modes are CL, FLX/MCT, TOGA, and MREV (). STALL is a fault condition, not a limit mode.

question: What is the linear relationship between Throttle Lever Angle (TLA) and Throttle Resolver Angle (TRA)?
justification: The manual states the relationship is linear and 1 degree TLA is 1.9 degrees TRA ().

question: At what TLA is the MAX CLIMB detent point set?
justification: In the forward thrust area, the MAX CLIMB detent point is set to 25 deg.TLA ().

question: What is the N1 target if the aircraft enters an Alpha Floor condition?
justification: In Alpha Floor condition, the A/THR function becomes active automatically and the N1 target is TOGA ().

question: What is the active range for A/THR function when both engines are running?
justification: A/THR function is normally active when the throttle levers are set between IDLE and CLimb (including CLimb) ().

question: How is the A/THR function disengaged via the throttle levers?

options.a: By pulling the reverse latching lever
options.b: By setting the levers at IDLE stop
options.c: By moving the levers into the TOGA detent

justification: The A/THR function is disengaged when the throttle levers are set at IDLE stop ().

question: What is the maximum allowable discrepancy between the signals generated by the two throttle resolvers?
justification: The maximum discrepancy between the signals generated by two resolvers is 0.25 deg.TRA ().

question: Which of these is considered an engine primary monitoring parameter on the ECAM EWD?
justification: Primary monitoring parameters on the EWD include N1, EGT, N2, and Fuel Flow (). Oil and nacelle temp are secondary.

question: Where is the N1 speed sensor installed?

options.a: On the accessory gearbox rear face
options.b: In the fan frame strut No. 6 at 5:00 o'clock

justification: The N1 speed sensor is installed in the fan frame strut No. 6 at the 5:00 o'clock position ().

question: How is the vibration indication processed for display on the ECAM SD?

options.a: As an absolute value in millimeters per second
options.b: As a ratio of actual value to maximum value multiplied by 10
options.c: As a percentage of the N1 speed

justification: The EVMU processes the ratio actual value/maxi value, which is multiplied by 10 and available for display ().

question: What is the maximum fuel flow capacity of the Fuel Flow transmitter?
justification: The maximum flow across the FF transmitter (XMTR) is 6360 kg/hr ().

question: How many thermocouple probes are used to sense and average engine EGT?
justification: The engine EGT is sensed and averaged by 9 thermocouple probes ().

question: At what differential pressure range is the main oil filter clog indication generated?
justification: The main oil filter clog indication is generated when the oil differential pressure is between 29 psig (2 bar) and 33 psig (2.28 bar) ().

question: Which sensor is used as a back-up for the N1 bearing accelerometer?

options.b: The Turbine Rear Frame (TRF) vibration sensor

justification: The TRF vibration sensor is used as back-up of the N1 bearing accelerometer ().

question: When does the ECAM system display the 'Nacelle Temperature' indication?

options.a: Permanently during all phases of flight
options.c: Non-permanently, displayed in case of a too high temperature

justification: Nacelle temperature indication is non-permanently displayed on the SD only in case of a too high temperature (pages 396, 397).

question: How is a fuel filter clog indicated to the crew?

options.b: An amber 'CLOG' message associated with an ECAM message
options.c: A red pop-out indicator on the cockpit center pedestal

justification: A CLOG message appears in amber, associated with an ECAM message only when differential pressure across the fuel filter is excessive ().

question: Which of these ECAM indications is only displayed during the engine start sequence?
justification: The manual states 'These indications (Ignition, Start Valve, Engine Bleed) are only displayed during the start sequence' ().

question: How many pivoting blocker doors are installed around the nacelle for each engine?
justification: The system consists of 4 pivoting blocker doors ().

question: When is thrust reverser operation possible?
justification: Thrust reverser operation is possible on ground only ().

question: Which hydraulic system supplies the actuators for Engine No. 2?
justification: Hydraulic power is supplied by the green system for engine 1 and yellow system for engine 2 ().

question: According to the manual warning, what must be done before working on the engine to prevent accidental TR operation?

options.a: Open the LH fan cowl door
options.b: Deactivate the system using the HCU lever

justification: WARNING: The thrust reverser system should be deactivated using the HCU lever, before working on the system or on the engine ().

question: Per the MEL, how are the pivoting doors secured if an aircraft must be dispatched with an inoperative thrust reverser?

options.a: Using a mechanical rope in the bypass duct
options.b: By installing special lockout bolts and red lock plates
options.c: By closing the pneumatic start SOV

justification: To lockout the pivoting doors, special lockout bolts and red lock plates are installed to secure them to the structure (/501).

question: What must be installed when a pivoting door is manually opened to secure it in the open position?

options.a: A red lock plate on the storage bracket
options.b: A safety sleeve on the hydraulic actuator rod
options.c: A quick release pin through the door hook

justification: When the pivoting door is open, a safety sleeve must be installed to secure it in the open position (/522).

question: When does the 'REV' indication on the ECAM change from amber to green?

options.a: When the TLA is set to -4.3 deg
options.b: When each pivoting door overshoots 95% of its travel
options.c: Immediately upon manual selection in the cockpit

justification: When each pivoting door overshoots 95% of its travel, the deploy switches are closed and the REV indication changes to green ().

question: How many pumps are contained within the lubrication unit housing?
justification: The lubrication unit has five positive displacement pumps: one oil supply and 4 scavenge pumps ().

question: What is the purpose of the anti-siphon device in the oil system?

options.a: To increase supply pump output pressure
options.b: To prevent oil from draining by gravity from the tank into the gearbox after shutdown
options.c: To bleed air from the main oil/fuel heat exchanger

justification: The anti-siphon device prevents oil from draining by gravity into the gearbox after engine shutdown ().

question: In the event of main oil filter clogging, how is lubrication maintained?

options.a: The supply pump automatically doubles its RPM
options.b: A bypass valve opens and oil flows through a backup filter
options.c: The FADEC initiates an automatic emergency shutdown

justification: If the main filter becomes clogged, a bypass valve opens and the oil flows through the backup filter ().

question: Before returning to the tank, scavenged oil from the forward and aft sumps passes through what first?
justification: Scavenged oil circulates successively through the 4 scavenge screens and then the master magnetic chip detector ().

question: According to the manual, for how long should the engine be shut down before starting oil servicing?
justification: The engine should be shut down for at least 5 minutes prior to oil servicing to allow residual pressure to decrease (/493).

question: To check for contamination, how is the EMCD plug removed?
justification: To check for contamination, remove the probe by pushing and turning the EMCD plug 1/4 turn counter-clockwise (/497).

question: Which statement is true regarding the intermixing of approved engine oils?

options.a: Different brands of the same oil type are incompatible
options.b: Intermixing among different brands should be avoided
options.c: Only Royco Turbine Oil 500 can be mixed with Castrol 5000

justification: The manual states: 'There are no incompatibilities among same oil type. However intermixing among different brands should be avoided' (/554).

question: What must be verified when re-installing the EMCD probe?

options.a: That the safety pin with streamer is removed
options.b: That the RED marks are aligned
options.c: That the bypass valve is set to NORM

justification: When re-installing the EMCD, verify that the RED marks are aligned (/497).

question: How are the control channels designated in the Electronic Engine Control (EEC/ECU) of the A320 engines?
justification: The Electronic Engine Control (EEC) consists of two channels A and B. (Book 5A, p. 130 / Book 5B, p. 218)

subtopic: Engine fuel LP and HP pumps
question: On the IAE V2500 engine, where are the fuel pump and the FMU located?

options.a: On the LH side of the fan case
options.c: On the forward part of the pylon

justification: The fuel pump and the FMU are on the gearbox.

question: In the event of a single input signal failure to the EEC, how does the FADEC respond?

options.a: It immediately performs an automatic channel changeover
options.b: The channel in control uses inputs from the other channel via the cross channel data link
options.c: The engine is automatically shut down for fail-safe protection

justification: In case of single input signal failure, there is no channel changeover, the channel in control uses the inputs from the other channel through the cross channel data link.

question: When the Master switch is set from ON to OFF on the IAE V2500, which component is directly energized to stop fuel flow?

options.b: The Pressure Raising and Shut Off Valve (PRSOV) Torque Motor

justification: When the Master switch is set from On to OFF, an electrical signal is sent directly to the Pressure Raising and Shut Off Valve (PRSOV) Torque Motor (TM).

subtopic: Fuel flow control and N1/EPR scheduling
question: If the T2 sensor is no longer available on an IAE V2500, what is the resulting FADEC mode and limitation?

options.a: Rated N1 mode; N1 limit is computed using T3
options.b: Unrated N1 mode; N1 limitation is no longer computed
options.c: EPR mode; the system uses ADIRU TAT as a backup

justification: T2 is no longer available; the EEC reverts from the EPR mode to the unrated N1 mode. In this case the N1 limitation is no longer computed.

subtopic: High pressure fuel filter and fuel/oil heat exchanger
question: What is the function of the Fuel Cooled Oil Cooler (FCOC) in the IAE V2500 fuel system?

options.a: It uses engine oil to heat the fuel before the LP pump
options.b: It cools the engine oil using fuel as a heat sink
options.c: It uses fan air to cool the fuel before it enters the FMU

justification: The Fuel Cooled Oil Cooler (FCOC) cools the engine oil by using fuel.

subtopic: Fuel metering unit and hydromechanical unit (HMU)
question: Which component manages the fuel recirculation inside the IAE V2500 engine fuel system to maintain oil and fuel temperatures?

options.b: The Fuel Diverter and Return to tank Valve (FDRV)

justification: The two-position diverter valve works by managing the fuel recirculation inside the engine fuel system.

subtopic: Fuel system ECAM indications and warnings
question: What is the trigger for the 'CLOG' message to appear in amber on the ECAM SD Engine page?

options.a: Low fuel pressure at the HP pump inlet
options.b: High differential pressure across the fuel filter
options.c: High fuel temperature at the burner nozzles

justification: A CLOG message appears in amber... only when the differential pressure across the fuel filter is too high/excessive. (Book 5A, p. 310 / Book 5B, p. 404)

subtopic: FADEC power supply and permanent magnet alternator (PMA)
question: When N2 is below 10% on the V2500, what provides the 28V DC power supply to the EEC?

options.b: The aircraft 28V DC network via the EIU
options.c: The 115V AC ignition supply via a transformer

justification: The EEC is supplied by the A/C electrical power network when N2 is below 10%... through the Engine Interface Unit (EIU).

question: If both EEC channels A and B are operational on a V2500, how many channels deliver output commands simultaneously?

options.c: Channel A is always master; B is only for crosschecking

justification: All the EEC outputs are double, but only the channel in control supplies the engine control signals.

question: Where is the LP fuel Shut-Off Valve (SOV) controlled from?

options.a: Only from the Engine Fire Panel
options.b: Only from the Engine Start Panel
options.c: From the engine fire panel or from the engine start panel

justification: The LP fuel Shut-Off Valve (SOV) operation is controlled from the engine fire panel or from the engine start panel. (Book 5A, p. 109 / Book 5B, p. 206)

question: On the CFM56-5B, what is the default selection strategy for the 'Active Channel' when both channels have the same health status?

options.b: Selection alternates after every engine start
options.c: The selection is randomized by the EIU

justification: When both channels have the same health status, Active and Stand-by Channel selection alternates after every engine start.

subtopic: FADEC power supply and permanent magnet alternator (PMA)
question: What is the function of the time-delay relay in the V2500 PRSOV control circuit after engine shutdown?

options.a: To delay the closing of the LP SOV for 2 minutes
options.b: To de-energize the PRSOV latching torque motor 2 minutes after shutdown to avoid high temperature damage
options.c: To provide power to the EEC for post-flight BITE tests

justification: A time-delay relay automatically de-energizes the pressure raising and SOV latching torque motor 2 minutes after engine shutdown. This device avoids damage due to high temperature.

question: How is the overspeed governor system on the CFM56-5B categorized in terms of its relation to the FADEC?

options.b: Hydro-mechanical and independent of the ECU

justification: The overspeed governor is hydro-mechanical (flyweights) and independent of the ECU.

subtopic: Ignition exciter units location and function
question: Where are the two ignition boxes located on the IAE V2500 engine?

options.a: On the LH side of the fan case
options.b: On the RH side of the engine core

justification: Two ignition boxes are on the RH side of the engine core.

subtopic: Igniter plug types, location, and replacement limits
question: On the IAE V2500, how are the ignition exciters and igniter plugs connected?

options.a: Via a standard 28V DC wire harness
options.b: Via a coaxial shield ignition lead

justification: Each subsystem includes an ignition exciter, a coaxial shield ignition lead and an igniter plug.

question: Which of the following conditions will trigger automatic continuous ignition on the IAE V2500?

options.c: Both Master Levers cycled to OFF

justification: Automatic Selection [of Continuous Ignition]: Engine Anti-ice ON, EIU has failed, Take Off, etc.

question: During a manual start on the IAE V2500, when is the ignition system energized?

options.a: When the MAN START P/B is pressed in
options.b: When the MASTER control lever is set to the ON position

justification: During a manual start... then the ignition system is energized when the MASTER control lever is set to the ON position.

subtopic: In-flight relight envelope and windmill start
question: If IGN START is re-selected with an engine running (IAE V2500), how many igniters are supplied?

options.a: Only the igniter scheduled for the next start
options.b: Both igniters together to provide continuous ignition
options.c: Ignition is inhibited if the engine is already running

justification: IF IGNition START is reselected with an engine running, the corresponding EEC supplies the 2 igniters together, to provide continuous ignition.

subtopic: Ignition power supply and circuit breakers
question: What is the voltage supply sent by the EEC and Relay Box to the ignition boxes?
justification: WARNING: THE EEC AND THE RELAY BOX SEND 115 VOLTS TO THE IGNITION BOXES. (Book 5A, p. 148 / Book 5B, p. 235)

subtopic: Ignition exciter units location and function
question: What component allows the IAE V2500 start valve to be operated in the event of an electrical failure?
justification: To increase A/C dispatch, the start valve is equipped with a manual override.

question: If an ignition fault is detected during an automatic start on the IAE V2500, what is the FADEC's first action?

options.b: Stop the fuel supply and ignition, then perform a dry crank phase
options.c: Display a 'FAULT' message and continue the start using the healthy channel

justification: The FADEC stops the fuel supply and ignition, and automatically supplies airflow [dry crank] to the engine.

subtopic: Thrust Lever Angle (TLA) signal and FADEC interface
question: What is the angular relationship between the Throttle Lever Angle (TLA) and the Throttle Resolver Angle (TRA)?
justification: 1° of TLA corresponds to 1.9° of TRA. (Book 5A, p. 130 / Book 5B, p. 225)

subtopic: Engine rating modes (TOGA, FLX/MCT, CLB, CRU, IDLE)
question: Which ECAM page is automatically displayed when the mode selector is set to IGN/START?
justification: When IGNition START is selected the ENGINE page is called automatically.

question: What is the 'fail-safe' position for the Variable Stator Vane (VSV) if the EEC is unable to control them?
justification: If the channel is faulty and the remaining channel in control is unable to control the Variable Stator Vane (VSV) position, the vanes are set to the fail-safe open position.

subtopic: Thrust reverse electrical and mechanical interlock
question: For a V2500 engine, at what TLA detection does the reverser Shut-Off Valve (SOV) open?
justification: When the potentiometers detect a Throttle Lever Angle (TLA) lower than -3°, the SOV opens.

subtopic: Manual thrust control in FADEC degraded mode
question: On the CFM56, if the 'Rated N1' mode is active, which parameter is used by the EEC to limit engine thrust?
justification: The EEC uses TLA, ADR and T2. T2 is used in N1 rated mode to limit the engine thrust.

subtopic: Alpha floor protection and autothrust interface
question: In an 'Alpha Floor' condition, what is the automatic EPR target set by the FMGS/FADEC?
justification: In alpha floor condition the auto thrust function becomes active automatically. The EPR target is TOGA. (Book 5A, p. 277 / Book 5B, p. 371)

subtopic: FADEC ground and flight mode differences
question: What 'aircraft on ground' signal is required by the EEC before it will command the thrust reverser to deploy?

options.c: Signal from the Weight on Wheels (WoW) relay in the EIU

justification: To command the thrust reverser, the EEC needs an 'aircraft on ground' signal supplied by the Landing Gear Control and Interface Units (LGCIUs). (Book 5A, p. 325 / Book 5B, p. 416)

question: Where is the N1 rating limit displayed on the ECAM?

options.a: As an amber line on the N1 dial
options.b: In green on the upper ECAM display near the mode indication
options.c: On the secondary engine page only

justification: This indication is displayed in green on the upper ECAM display near the thrust limit mode indication.

subtopic: Thrust Lever Angle (TLA) signal and FADEC interface
question: Which unit provides the 'artificial feel' and transmits throttle movement to the mechanical rod?

options.b: The throttle control artificial feel unit

justification: This rod drives the input lever of the throttle control artificial feel unit. (Book 5A, p. 287 / Book 5B, p. 377)

subtopic: Primary parameters: N1, EGT, FF (CFM) / EPR, EGT (IAE)
question: Which of the following is considered a primary engine parameter on the IAE V2500 EWD?
justification: The engine primary monitoring parameters displayed on the ECAM EWD are: EPR, EGT, N1, FF, N2...

subtopic: Secondary parameters: N2, oil pressure, oil temp, vibration
question: Where is the oil quantity transmitter (XMTR) located on both A320 engine types?
justification: The oil quantity XMTR is located in the oil tank. (Book 5A, p. 305 / Book 5B, p. 399)

subtopic: Engine vibration monitoring unit (VMU) and sensors
question: What is the equivalent value in IPS (Inch Per Second) for 1 unit of vibration displayed on the ECAM?
justification: 1 unit for N1 or N2 rotor corresponds to 0.3IPS (Inch Per Second).

subtopic: ECAM ENG page primary and secondary display layout
question: When is the 'Nacelle Temperature' indication displayed on the ECAM?

options.c: Displayed if it is at or above 320°C (IAE) or in case of high temperature (CFM)

justification: NACELLE TEMPERATURE INDICATION (DISPLAYED IF ONE NACELLE TEMPERATURE IS AT OR ABOVE 320°C). (Book 5A, p. 303 / Book 5B, p. 397/406)

subtopic: Dual engine monitoring in FADEC cross-channel data
question: In case of SDAC failure, which unit acts as a backup to send oil quantity and pressure data to the DMCs?
justification: In case of SDACs failure, the EIU sends data to DMCs by the FWCs.

subtopic: Secondary parameters: N2, oil pressure, oil temp, vibration
question: Which secondary parameters are also displayed on the ECAM CRUISE page?

options.b: Fuel used, oil quantity and vibration
options.c: Start valve position and Igniter status

justification: Fuel used, oil quantity and vibration indications are also displayed on the ECAM CRUISE page. (Book 5A, p. 302 / Book 5B, p. 396)

subtopic: Engine vibration monitoring unit (VMU) and sensors
question: What is the function of the N1 'trim balance sensor' on the IAE V2500?

options.a: It provides a backup N1 signal to the EEC
options.b: It sends N1 analog signals to the EVMU for on-board fan trim balancing
options.c: It limits N1 speed during high vibration events

justification: One sensor sends N1 analog signals (trim balance sensor) to the Engine Vibration Monitoring Unit... and is capable of on-board fan trim balancing. (Book 5A, p. 296/292)

subtopic: Primary parameters: N1, EGT, FF (CFM) / EPR, EGT (IAE)
question: How many thermocouple probes sense the engine EGT on a CFM56-5B?
justification: The engine EGT is sensed and averaged by 9 thermocouple probes located in the T49.5 plane.

question: What happens if the oil pressure drops below 60 PSI on a V2500 engine?

options.b: The ECU automatically shuts down the engine
options.c: The oil low pressure switch triggers an LOP warning and the indication becomes red

justification: The Oil LOW PRESSURE switch sends its discrete signal... when the pressure drops below 60 PSI.... indication becomes amber [below 80] and red if the pressure drops below 60 PSI.

question: On the IAE V2500 engine, how many internal discharge ports are contained within the Fuel Distribution Valve (FDV)?
justification: The FDV receives metered fuel... then into ten internal discharge ports.

question: In the IAE V2500 fuel system, what happens if the fuel filter becomes clogged?

options.a: The engine is automatically shut down by the EEC
options.b: A bypass valve opens in the fuel filter pressure plate to ensure continued flow
options.c: The LP pump pressure is increased to force fuel through the filter

justification: The fuel filter bypass valve makes sure that the fuel still flow in the event of fuel filter clogging. (Book 5A, p. 85/86)

question: Under what condition does the IAE V2500 EEC use synthesized values for engine control?
justification: Dual input signal failure, the system runs on synthesized values of the healthiest channel.

question: In the IAE V2500 FADEC system, if Channel A fails, how does Channel B receive command signals from the EIU?

options.a: Directly from the EIU via its own ARINC 429 bus
options.b: Via a cross-channel data link from Channel A only
options.c: It does not receive signals; Channel B is strictly a monitor

justification: Each channel receives inputs for both the Air Data/Inertial Reference Units (ADIRUs) and the EIU. [Note: Unlike CFM where EIU data is only received by Chan A, V2500 EEC channels receive inputs independently].

question: How many fuel manifolds are used to supply the 20 nozzles on the IAE V2500 engine?
justification: The fuel flow is then routed to a fuel distribution valve, which supplies 20 nozzles through 10 manifolds.

question: In the IAE V2500 heat management system, which modes represent 'no return to tank' conditions?
justification: Modes 3 and 5 are no return to tank modes.

question: If both EEC channels A and B experience a complete output signal failure on a V2500, what is the effect on the engine components?

options.a: They remain in their last commanded position
options.b: They are moved to a fail-safe position
options.c: The engine continues at the current power setting via mechanical links

justification: Complete output signal failure, there is no longer any current... the related component will go to the 'fail-safe' position.

question: On the IAE V2500, what happens in Mode 3 when the engine is at a high power setting?

options.a: All heat is absorbed by the burned fuel and return to wing tank is stopped
options.b: The IDG oil is cooled by fan air through the ACOC exclusively
options.c: Fuel is returned to the tank at a rate of 1000 kg/h

justification: MODE 3: Engine at high power setting: In this condition all the heat is absorbed by the burned fuel... The fuel flow to the wing tank is stopped.

question: When validating air data for engine control on the V2500, which data source is preferred by the EEC?
justification: The EEC performs validation tests... ADIRU data is preferred over engine data.

question: Which component in the IAE V2500 fuel system allows for fuel flow adjustment between 'high flow' and 'normal flow' by maintenance personnel?
justification: A flow adjuster installed below the metering valve is used for the fuel flow adjustment... by a maintenance action.

question: What is the working range for analog inputs received by the IAE V2500 Engine Interface Unit (EIU)?
justification: Analog inputs which are of the differential type with a working range of 1 to 9 volts.

question: On the IAE V2500, what happens to the fuel remaining in the upper eight manifolds at engine shutdown?

options.a: It is sucked back to the oil tank
options.b: It is drained into the engine through the two lowest fuel manifolds
options.c: It is trapped in the manifolds by the check valves

justification: This lets remaining fuel from the upper eight fuel manifolds to be drained into the engine through the two lowest fuel manifolds.

question: If the IDG oil temperature is excessive on an IAE V2500, how does the heat management system respond regarding fuel return?

options.b: Return to tank is not permissible (Mode 5 - Fail-safe)
options.c: It initiates an automatic IDG disconnect

justification: MODE 5:... return to tank is not permissible due to the high return fuel temperature [caused by excessive IDG temp].

question: How is the return fuel flow to the aircraft tanks modulated on the IAE V2500?

options.a: By a three-way solenoid on the EEC
options.b: By the Fuel Diverter and Return to tank Valve (FDRV) through software logic based on oil/fuel limits
options.c: By a dedicated pump in the pylon

justification: The EEC processes the operation modes of the fuel diverter and return valve by software logic... generated around the limiting temperatures of fuel and oil.

question: What protection is provided if the 200-micron strainer in the IAE V2500 Fuel Distribution Valve becomes blocked?

options.a: A clog signal is sent to the EEC

justification: The fuel goes through a 200-micron strainer... If the strainer gets blocked, a bypass valve will open.

question: Where is the Fuel Cooled Oil Cooler (FCOC) installed on the IAE V2500 engine?

options.a: On the RH side of the core

justification: The Fuel Cooled Oil Cooler (FCOC)... is installed on the left fan case.

question: On the IAE V2500, how many N1 speed sensors are installed in the front bearing compartment to support the EEC channels?
justification: The fan speed (N1) indicating system has 4 sensors: o two sensors... o one sensor is a spare... (Total 3 sensors for EEC). [Note: The 4th is for VMU].

question: Which computer acts as the primary interface concentrator between the A/C systems and the FADEC system for both engine types?

options.a: The Flight Management and Guidance Computer (FMGC)

justification: The EIU is an interface concentrator that serves as the communication link, between the A/C systems and the FADEC system. (Book 5A, p. 140 / Book 5B, p. 220)

subtopic: Fuel Diverter and Return Valve operation
question: On the IAE V2500, what is the 'fail-safe' mode of operation for the heat management system?
justification: MODE 5:... NOTE: This is the fail-safe mode of operation.

question: What is the weight of the IAE V2500 air starter?
justification: BE CAREFUL DURING REMOVAL OR INSTALLATION OF THE STARTER, IT WEIGHS 33 LBS (15 KG).

question: On the IAE V2500, at what N2 speed should the ground crew be told to close the start valve during a manual start?
justification: When N2 is at 43%, tell the ground crew to close the start valve.

question: What is the primary function of the ignition boxes (exciters) on the IAE V2500 engine?

options.a: To provide high-pressure air for starting
options.b: To convert 115 Volts into high voltage, high-energy pulses
options.c: To monitor the spark duration for the FADEC

justification: THE EEC AND THE RELAY BOX SEND 115 VOLTS TO THE IGNITION BOXES, WHICH CONVERT IT AND SEND HIGH ENERGY PULSES.

question: What is the maximum continuous operation limit for the IAE V2500 starter during motoring?
justification: Or 4 continuous minutes on, then 30 minutes off for cooling.

question: During an IAE V2500 automatic start, the EEC closes the start valve and cuts off ignition when N2 reaches:
justification: When N2 reaches 43%, the EEC closes the starter valve and cuts off the ignition.

question: If an engine stall is sensed during an IAE V2500 automatic start, what is the FADEC's immediate action?

options.a: It resets the EEC and tries again after 30 seconds
options.b: It stops fuel and ignition, performs a dry crank phase, and then aborts the sequence
options.c: It forces the engine into Mode 5 fail-safe

justification: The FADEC stops the fuel and the ignition, then a dry crank phase is automatically done. After the auto-cranking, the FADEC aborts the start sequence.

question: After three consecutive cycles of 2 minutes on / 15 seconds off, how long must the IAE V2500 starter cool down?
justification: 3 consecutive cycles; 2 minutes on, 15 seconds off up 2 times and one minute on, then 30 minutes off for cooling.

question: Which EIU logic will trigger automatic continuous ignition on the IAE V2500?

options.a: Approach idle selected by the EIU
options.c: Master lever set to ON for the second engine start

justification: Automatic Selection [of Continuous Ignition]:... Approach idle selected by the EIU.

question: To start a manual engine start sequence on the IAE V2500, what is the first cockpit action after selecting IGN START?

options.b: Press the ENG MAN START P/B to ON
options.c: Select CRANK on the mode selector

justification: Action on the ENG MANual START P/B opens the starter valve, via the EEC. After 30 seconds dry crank, set the ENG/MASTER control switch to ON.

question: What happens if you open the IAE V2500 starter valve manual override without the starter system being pressurized?

options.a: The engine will dry crank slowly
options.c: Damage to the valve can occur

justification: NOTE: Do not operate the valve unless the starter system is pressurized. Damage to the valve can occur.

question: If an automatic start on an IAE V2500 engine fails, why must the MASTER lever be set to OFF after the FADEC aborts the sequence?

options.b: To confirm the abort and allow the sequence to fully terminate
options.c: To manually close the LP SOV

justification: After the auto cranking, the FADEC aborts the start sequence. Then the MASTER lever must be set to OFF. (Book 5A, p. 209/234)

question: What is the time limit for motoring the IAE V2500 engine with the MASTER control switch in the ON position during a wet crank?
justification: CAUTION: - DO NOT MOTOR THE ENGINE FOR MORE THAN 15 SECONDS WITH THE MASTER CONTROL SWITCH IN THE ON POSITION.

question: During an IAE V2500 manual start, what happens immediately after the MASTER lever is set to ON?

options.a: Only ignition system A is energized
options.b: Both ignition systems are energized and LP/pressure raising SOVs open
options.c: The start valve opens automatically via EEC logic

justification: As soon as the MASTER lever is in the ON position, both ignition systems are energized, LP and pressure raising SOVs open and the fuel flow increases.

question: In the IAE V2500, what happens if the MASTER lever is cycled from ON to OFF then back to ON with the engine running?

options.b: The continuous ignition function is automatically selected
options.c: The EEC reverts to unrated N1 mode

justification: Automatic Selection [of Continuous Ignition]:... MASTER LEVER CYCLED FROM ON TO OFF THEN BACK TO ON.

question: What tool is used to move the start valve manual handle to the OPEN position on the IAE V2500?
justification: Use a 3/8" square drive to move the start valve manual handle to the OPEN position.

question: After performing a wet crank on the IAE V2500, for how long should the engine be dry cranked to eliminate fuel vapors?
justification: After wet cranking... Continue to dry crank for at least 60 seconds.

question: Which ECAM message and light appear if the IAE V2500 start valve fails to open?

options.a: ENG 1 START VALVE FAULT message and engine FAULT light
options.b: X BLEED VALVE NOT OPEN message and engine FIRE light
options.c: STARTER PRESS LOW message and MASTER CAUTION light

justification: If the start valve does not open... The MASTER CAUTion and the ENGine FAULT lights come on. An ECAM message comes into view.

question: When is the continuous relight function cut off on both A320 engine types?

options.b: When the mode selector is moved back to the NORM position

justification: The continuous relight is cut off in MODE NORMal. (Book 5A, p. 179 / Book 5B, p. 253/273)

question: If an IAE V2500 start valve fails to close at 43% N2, which procedure must be performed by the crew?

options.a: Manually close the valve via the 3/8" square drive
options.b: START VALVE NOT CLOSED procedure, including setting X BLEED to SHUT
options.c: Select MODE selector to CRANK to reset the EEC

justification: If the start valve does not close... You must perform the START VALVE NOT CLOSED procedure. For this, you must remove all bleed sources... Set the X BLEED selector to SHUT. (Book 5A, p. 199/224)

question: How many resolvers are contained within the Throttle Control Unit (TCU) for engine control?
justification: The throttle control unit comprises:... -2 resolvers (one resolver per FADEC channel). (Book 5A, p. 379 / Book 5B, p. 379)

question: Where are the Engine Interface Units (EIUs) located in the aircraft?
justification: Each EIU, located in the avionics bay, is an interface concentrator. (Book 5A, p. 133 / Book 5B, p. 222)

question: On the throttle control lever, which TLA corresponds to the 'Max Climb' detent point?
justification: In the forward thrust area, there are two detent points, the MAX CLIMB detent point set to 25 deg.TLA. (Book 5A, p. 377 / Book 5B, p. 377)

question: What thrust limit mode is displayed on the ECAM if the throttle levers are set at the 35 degree TLA position on the ground?
justification: The MAX CONTINUOUS/FLEX TAKE-OFF detent point set to 35 deg.TLA.... On ground... FLEX N1 is displayed whenever the thrust lever position is between IDLE and FLX/MCT. (Book 5A, p. 377 / Book 5B, p. 361)

question: If electrical power to the EIU is lost, what is the effect on engine starting?

options.a: The engine can still be started in manual mode
options.b: Engine start or restart is not possible
options.c: The engine automatically restarts in continuous relight mode

justification: NOTE: If the EIU electrical power is lost, the EIU fails and engine start or restart is not possible.

question: How does the autothrust function behave when the aircraft enters an 'Alpha Floor' condition?

options.a: It disconnects to allow manual pilot control
options.b: It becomes active automatically and sets the N1 target to TOGA
options.c: It limits engine output to MCT to prevent overboost

justification: Note: In Alpha Floor condition the A/THR function becomes active automatically. The N1 target is TOGA.

question: When engaged, when does the A/THR function become 'active' after takeoff?

options.a: As soon as the aircraft reaches 100 feet
options.b: When the throttle levers are set to the CLimb detent
options.c: When the landing gear is retracted

justification: When engaged, the A/THR function becomes active when the throttle levers are set to CLimb detent after take off.

question: If the throttle levers are set between two detent points, which detent determines the thrust limit mode?

options.c: Neither; the system stays in the previous mode

justification: If the throttle levers are set between two detent points, the upper detent will determine the thrust limit mode.

question: Which Throttle Resolver Angle (TRA) value range is considered a position signal failure by the IAE V2500 EEC?

options.a: Less than -20.0 deg.TRA or greater than +45.0 deg.TRA
options.b: Less than -47.5 deg.TRA or greater than 98.8 deg.TRA

justification: The ECU considers a throttle resolver angle value: - less than -47.5 deg.TRA or - greater than 98.8 deg.TRA as resolver position signal failure.

question: In case of a single engine operation on the IAE V2500, what is the active range of the auto thrust function?
justification: NOTE: The auto thrust function active range is extended to MCT in the case of single engine operation.

question: What is the total angular movement range of the throttle control lever (from full reverse to full forward)?
justification: The throttle control lever moves over a range from -20 deg. TLA (Reverser Full Throttle stop) to +45 deg. TLA. (Book 5A, p. 377 / Book 5B, p. 377)

question: How many Engine Interface Units (EIUs) are installed on the aircraft for engine control?

options.c: One central unit for both engines

justification: There is one EIU for each engine. (Book 5A, p. 140 / Book 5B, p. 222)

question: If FLEX mode is selected, where must the thrust lever be positioned for FLEX N1 to be displayed on the ground?
justification: If FLEX mode is selected, FLEX N1 is displayed whenever the thrust lever position is between IDLE and FLX/MCT.

question: What is the TLA detent point for the Maximum Continuous Thrust (MCT) mode?
justification: The MAX CONTINUOUS/FLEX TAKE-OFF detent point set to 35 deg.TLA. (Book 5A, p. 377 / Book 5B, p. 377)

question: Which action on the IAE V2500 sends an electrical signal to isolate the aircraft fuel system from the engine?

options.a: Moving the TLA to full reverse
options.b: Setting the Master switch to OFF
options.c: Opening the fuel cooled oil cooler bypass

justification: When the Master switch is set... to OFF... A second electrical signal is sent to the two motors of the LP Valve, which is controlled to close.

question: What happens to the EPR indicator on the ECAM if a sensor failure causes the V2500 FADEC to revert to rated N1 mode?

options.a: It turns amber and shows the N1 target
options.c: It is replaced by a green T2 indication

justification: In case of EPR sensor failure... the EPR indicator is crossed amber.

question: At what throttle lever position is the auto thrust function automatically disengaged?
justification: The A/THR function is disengaged when the throttle levers are set at IDLE stop. (Book 5A, p. 279 / Book 5B, p. 373)

question: What is the maximum allowable discrepancy between the signals generated by the two resolvers in the Throttle Control Unit?
justification: The maximum discrepancy between the signals generated by two resolvers is 0.25 deg.TRA.

question: On an IAE V2500, if the A/THR is active and the throttle levers are set between two detent points, what limits the EPR command?
justification: When the throttle levers are set between two detent points, the EPR command is limited by the throttle lever position.

question: Which signal from the IAE V2500 EIU tells the Bleed Monitoring Computer (BMC) to close the PRV during starting?

options.b: A ground signal when the start valve moves away from the closed position
options.c: When the mode selector is moved to CRANK

justification: The EIU generates a ground signal for the BMC when the start valve moves away from the closed position. On receipt of this ground signal, the BMC closes the... PRV.

question: Which component is pulled up to override the intermediate mechanical stop at 0 deg TLA on the throttle levers?
justification: This stop is overridden when the reverse latching lever is pulled up for selection of the reverse power. (Book 5A, p. 377 / Book 5B, p. 377)

question: On the IAE V2500 ECAM, where is the 'predicted EPR' (white circle) displayed?

options.c: In the center of the EWD

justification: The predicted Engine Pressure Ratio (EPR) is indicated by a white circle on the EPR indicator.

question: What happens if the A/THR is NOT active and the throttle levers are moved between 0 and 35 degrees TLA?

options.a: The FADEC automatically engages the A/THR
options.b: The engine control is in manual mode
options.c: The engine will stay at IDLE

justification: In the middle throttle range (0deg. To 35 deg.TLA)... If the autothrust is not engaged, the engine control is manual. (Book 5A, p. 377 / Book 5B, p. 377)

question: Which computer provides the 'A/C ON GROUND' signal to the EIU?
justification: A/C ON GROUND signal from LGCIU. (Shown in block diagrams: Book 5A, p. 142 / Book 5B, p. 229)

question: Which of the following is a discrete output sent by the EIU for engine operation?
justification: The EIU provides the following discrete outputs... start valve closure.

question: What replaces the white circle 'predicted EPR' on the IAE V2500 ECAM when N1 MODE is selected?
justification: On the N1 indicator, the predicted N1, i.e. the white circle, replaces the predicted EPR.

question: How many potentiometers are installed in the IAE V2500 Throttle Control Unit (TCU)?
justification: The throttle control unit comprises:... -6 potentiometers installed three by three.

question: What abbreviation is used on the ECAM for the Maximum Reverser thrust limit mode on the IAE V2500?
justification: The thrust limit modes are:... MREV: Maximum Reverser.

question: Which parameter from the engine oil system is sent as a discrete input to the EIU?
justification: The Engine Interface Unit (EIU) receives... LOP SW. (Block diagram: Book 5B, p. 229)

question: What is the TLA position for the single detent point in the reverse thrust range on the V2500?
justification: In the reverse thrust throttle range, there is one detent point at - 6 deg.TLA.

question: How many ARINC 429 output data buses are received by the IAE V2500 EIU from the EEC?
justification: The EIU receives 2 ARINC 429 output data buses from EEC channels A and B.

question: In the IAE V2500 'Unrated N1 mode', what happens to the engine protection against over-boost (e.g. during Go-Around)?

options.a: It is maintained using EGT limits
options.b: There is no longer an engine protection against over-boost
options.c: The FMGC takes over over-boost protection via the EIU

justification: NOTE: in unrated N1 mode, there is no longer an engine protection against over boost, e.g. Go-Around.

question: On the CFM56-5B, at what N2 percentage is the FADEC logic automatically switched to Control Alternator supply?
justification: Above 58% of N2, the ECU logic automatically switches to the control alternator supply.

question: Which system provides digital inputs to the IAE V2500 EIU for the auto-thrust function?
justification: The Engine Interface Unit (EIU) receives digital inputs from:... the Flight Control Unit (FCU) for the auto-thrust function.

question: What is the electrical excitation current provided by each IAE V2500 FADEC channel to its dedicated throttle resolver?
justification: Each resolver... receives its electrical excitation current (6 VAC) from the related FADEC channel.

question: Which TLA position corresponds to the 'Reverser Full Throttle stop'?
justification: -20 degrees TLA corresponds to Reverser Full Throttle stop. (Book 5A, p. 377 / Book 5B, p. 377)

question: Which computer sends digital inputs to the IAE V2500 EIU for engine troubleshooting and tests?
justification: The Engine Interface Unit (EIU) receives digital inputs from: - the Centralized Fault Display Interface Unit (CFDIU) for engine troubleshooting and test.

question: On the IAE V2500, what happens to the EPR thrust limit indication if N1 MODE is forced?

options.b: The N1 MODE limit is displayed instead of the EPR limit

justification: On the ECAM... the N1 MODE limit is displayed instead of the EPR limit.

question: What is the N2 threshold for the IAE V2500 EEC to automatically switch from A/C 28V DC to its dedicated alternator supply?
justification: As soon as the engine is running above 10% of N2, the dedicated alternator directly supplies the EEC.

question: To which computer does the IAE V2500 EIU send digital outputs for pneumatic valve operation?
justification: The EIU sends digital outputs to: - the Bleed Monitoring Computer (BMC) for pneumatic valve operation.

question: In the IAE V2500 FADEC system, what is the effect if Mach number input from the ADIRU is invalid but TAT and Pressure remain available?

options.a: EEC reverts to Unrated N1 mode
options.b: EEC uses engine sensors to validate and stays in EPR mode if possible
options.c: EEC reverts to a fixed IDLE setting

justification: The EEC performs validation tests and selection logic... ADIRU data is preferred... The air data used to validate... [Logic indicates it stays in EPR mode using validated air data sources].

question: Which TLA position on the V2500 corresponds to 'Forward Full Throttle stop'?
justification: +45 degrees TLA corresponds to Forward Full Throttle stop.

question: What happens if the EIU receives an 'A/C on ground' signal from LGCIU and a 'TLA reverse' signal from TCU?

options.b: It energizes the inhibition relay for thrust reverser deployment
options.c: It forces the engine to approach idle

justification: When the aircraft on ground signals from LGCIU and TLA reverse signal from TCU are sent to EIU, the EIU energize the inhibition relay.

question: On an IAE V2500, what occurs if the EIU has failed while the engine is running?

options.b: The continuous relight function is automatically selected by the EEC
options.c: The engine continues in manual mode but cannot be restarted if shut down

justification: Automatic Selection [of Continuous Ignition]:... EIU HAS FAILED.

question: Where is the N2 speed sensor installed on the IAE V2500 engine?

options.a: On the fan frame strut No. 6
options.b: At the front face of the accessory gearbox

justification: The N2 speed signal is sensed by the dedicated alternator, installed at the front face of the accessory gearbox.

question: How many thermocouple probe assemblies are used to sense and average the EGT on an IAE V2500 engine?
justification: The engine EGT is sensed and averaged by 4 thermocouple probe assemblies are located at station 4.95.

question: On the IAE V2500, at what differential pressure does the scavenge filter switch activate the ECAM CLOG warning?
justification: The ECAM is activated when the differential pressure is greater than 12 PSI. (Book 5A, p. 353/305)

question: On the IAE V2500, when does the oil pressure indication become red on the ECAM?
justification: If the oil pressure gets below 80 PSI the indication becomes amber and red if the pressure drops below 60 PSI.

question: On the IAE V2500, what happens if the oil temperature stays at 157°C for more than 15 minutes?

options.c: An automatic engine shutdown is initiated

justification: Normal temperature is indicated green on ECAM... or steady amber if over temperature condition of 157 °C lasts more than 15 minutes.

question: At which aerodynamic station plane are the IAE V2500 EGT sensors located?
justification: Thermocouple probe assemblies are located at station 4.95 (LP turbine exhaust case strut).

question: How is normal vibration processed for display on the ECAM SD?

options.a: As an raw IPS value ranging from 0 to 3.0
options.b: As a ratio of actual value to maximum value, multiplied by 10
options.c: As a percentage of N1 speed

justification: The EVMU processes the ratio actual value/maxi value. This ratio is multiplied by 10 and is available on the EVMU output. (Book 5A, p. 292 / Book 5B, p. 402)

question: On the IAE V2500, what is the maintenance requirement if contamination is found on the Master Magnetic Chip Detector (MCD)?

options.a: Clean the Master MCD and release the aircraft
options.c: Inspect ALL other MCDs on the engine

justification: Note: CONTAMINATION on Master MCD - Inspect ALL other MCD's.

question: On the IAE V2500, where is the Fuel Flow (FF) transmitter mounted?

options.a: On the RH side of the core at 12 o'clock
options.b: On the lower left-hand side of the fan case, rearward of the fuel pump
options.c: Between the FMU and the IDG oil cooler

justification: The fuel flow transmitter... is mounted on the lower left-hand side of the fan case, rearward of the LP/HP fuel pump.

question: Which of the following indications is ONLY displayed during the engine start sequence on the ECAM?

options.c: Start valve position and Ignition status

justification: * THESE INDICATIONS ARE ONLY DISPLAYED DURING THE START SEQUENCE. (Points to Ignition and Start Valve in diagram: Book 5A, p. 303 / Book 5B, p. 397)

question: At what threshold does the IAE V2500 oil pressure indication turn amber?
justification: If the oil pressure gets below 80 PSI the indication becomes amber.

question: On the IAE V2500, which optional sensor supplies air pressure from the LP compressor exit?
justification: P2.5 sensor supplies air pressure from the LP compressor exit.

question: On the IAE V2500, which component senses oil temperature for the Engine Condition Monitoring (signal to EIU)?

options.a: A dual resistor unit with a sealed wire-wound element
options.b: A single thermocouple on the oil tank
options.c: A probe in the fuel cooled oil cooler header

justification: The oil temperature is sensed by a dual resistor unit. The unit has a sealed, wire-wound resistance element.

question: Where is the vibration transducer installed on the IAE V2500 engine case?

options.a: In the fan case at the top left side
options.c: On the front flange of the TRF

justification: Each vibration transducer is installed in the fan case at the top left side of the engine.

question: In the IAE V2500 EGT measuring system, from which direction are the thermocouple probe locations (9.5, 7.5, 4.5, 2 o'clock) viewed?
justification: Probe assemblies are located... at 9.5, 7.5, 4.5 and 2 o'clock viewed from the rear.

question: At what oil temperature is a high oil temperature warning triggered on the IAE V2500?
justification: A high oil temperature warning is triggered, if the oil temperature reaches 165 °C.

question: Which unit computes the 'fuel used' value displayed on the ECAM SD?

options.b: The Full Authority Digital Engine Control (FADEC)

justification: The fuel used value computed by the Full Authority Digital Engine Control (FADEC) is displayed in green on the ECAM SD. (Book 5A, p. 310 / Book 5B, p. 404)

question: Which of the following secondary parameters is NOT permanently displayed on the ECAM ENGINE page?
justification: The engine secondary parameters non permanently displayed on the SD are:... nacelle temperature indication. (Book 5A, p. 302 / Book 5B, p. 396)

question: On the IAE V2500, what pressure threshold triggers the LOP (Low Oil Pressure) warning?
justification: The Oil LOW PRESSURE switch sends its discrete signal... when the pressure drops below 60 PSI.

question: On the IAE V2500, what provides the high pressure (HP) shaft rotational speed signal to the EEC and ECAM?

options.a: A magnetic pickup in the core
options.b: The dedicated alternator at the front of the accessory gearbox
options.c: A probe assembly at the N°4 bearing

justification: The N2 speed signal is sensed by the dedicated alternator, installed at the front face of the accessory gearbox.

question: On an IAE V2500, if an individual thermocouple probe in an EGT assembly fails, how does the system maintain an average value?

options.a: The EEC automatically reverts to rated N1 mode
options.b: The system averages the remaining valid signals from the 4 assemblies
options.c: The ECAM display turns red and marks 'XX'

justification: The engine EGT is sensed and averaged by 4 thermocouple probe assemblies. [Logic of averaging sensing points implies dismissal of invalid data]

question: On the IAE V2500, where is the scavenge oil temperature thermocouple located?

options.a: In the combined scavenge line between the master magnetic chip detector and the scavenge filter
options.b: Downstream of the pressure pump on the oil tank scupper
options.c: Upstream of the Air Cooled Oil Cooler

justification: The scavenge oil temperature thermocouple is located in the combined scavenge line between the master magnetic chip detector and the scavenge filter.

question: On the IAE V2500, which sensor provides air pressure from the fan exit for condition monitoring through the AIDS?
justification: P12.5 sensor supplies air pressure from the fan exit.

question: Which of the following parameters appears on the ECAM CRUISE page for the IAE V2500?
justification: Fuel used, oil quantity and vibration indications are also displayed on the ECAM CRUISE page.

question: What is the name of the measuring plane for EGT sensors on both A320 engine types?
justification: 9 thermocouple probes located in the T49.5 plane /...located at station 4.95.

question: A vibration reading of '3' on the engine ECAM indicates what value in Inch Per Second (IPS)?
justification: 1 unit for N1 or N2 rotor corresponds to 0.3IPS. (Book 5A, p. 292 / Book 5B, p. 402) [3 units x 0.3 = 0.9].

question: On the IAE V2500, at what differential pressure does the scavenge filter bypass valve open?
justification: The by-pass valve opens at 20 PSI.

question: On the IAE V2500, which sensor is specifically used for the 'on-board fan trim balancing' procedure?

options.a: A dual accelerometer on the core

justification: One sensor sends N1 analog signals (trim balance sensor) to the Engine Vibration Monitoring Unit... capable of on-board fan trim balancing. (Book 5A, p. 296/292)

question: At what temperature threshold is the nacelle temperature indication displayed on the IAE V2500 ECAM?
justification: NACELLE TEMPERATURE INDICATION (DISPLAYED IF ONE NACELLE TEMPERATURE IS AT OR ABOVE 320°C).

question: On the IAE V2500, which unit receives the oil temperature analog signal for use in the Heat Management System (HMS)?
justification: Such oil temp analog signal is sent to the related EEC for the Fuel Diverter and Return valve control.

question: On the IAE V2500, how is a transfer to the spare N1 speed sensor performed if the primary sensor fails?

options.a: Automatically in flight by the EEC
options.b: On the ground through the MCDU
options.c: Manually via a toggle switch in the avionics bay

justification: In case of sensor failure, the transfer to the second sensor is carried out on the ground through the MCDU.

question: At what pressure does the IAE V2500 cold start pressure relief valve open?
justification: The cold start pressure relief valve opens at 450 PSI.

question: Which of the following units does NOT receive a signal from the IAE V2500 N2 indicating system?
justification: The N2 indicating system sends signals... to the EEC... to the ECAM... and to the Engine Vibration Monitoring Unit.

question: On the IAE V2500, what is the measurement range for the oil temperature dual resistor unit?
justification: Temperature measurement range: -60°C to 250°C.

question: Where is the No. 4 bearing pressure transducer installed on the IAE V2500 engine?

options.b: On the right side of the deoiler

justification: The No.4 bearing pressure transducer is installed on the right side of the deoiler.

question: In the IAE V2500, what happens if the SDACs fail while trying to transmit oil quantity data to the DMCs?

options.a: The data is lost and display shows 'XX'
options.b: The EIU sends the data via the FWCs
options.c: The EEC sends the data directly via the high-speed ARINC bus

justification: If there is a failure of the SDACs, the EIU sends data to the DMCs by the FWCs. [Logic applies across single-aisle fleet data architecture].

question: How are the dual accelerometers (A and B) on the IAE V2500 managed during normal operations?

options.a: Both sensors are used and averaged
options.b: Only one sensor is used per flight, automatically selected by the EVMU
options.c: Sensor A is used for N1 and Sensor B for N2

justification: Only one sensor, A or B, of the dual accelerometer is used at a time and during one flight. It is automatically selected by the Engine Vibration Monitoring Unit (EVMU) at each flight.
